stories.title: Packers WR Reed to undergo season-ending neck surgery
stories.summary: Packers wide receiver Jayden Reed will undergo season-ending neck surgery and be placed on injured reserve, coach Matt LaFleur said Wednesday.

stories.title: Arizona State hockey coach put on leave amid inquiry into workout collapse
stories.summary: Arizona State hockey coach Greg Powers has been placed on paid administrative leave days after several members of his team asked the university to remove him pending an investigation into a teammate's collapse.

stories.title: Steelers rule CB Porter out for 4th game in row; CB Ramsey questionable
stories.summary: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter will miss his fourth straight game as he has officially been declared out for Thursday night's game against the Browns.
